reasoning: The question asks if a first-time winner will emerge at the 2026 World Cup. Historical evidence shows only 8 countries have ever won (Brazil, Germany, Italy, Argentina, France, Spain, England, Uruguay). The evidence consistently identifies the favorites as Argentina (defending champions), Spain (Euro 2024 winners, 31-match unbeaten streak), France, England, and Brazil - all previous winners. Dark horses mentioned include Portugal, Norway, and host nations, but these are considered long shots. The expanded 48-team format adds unpredictability, but traditional powers remain heavily favored. Given the historical dominance of past winners and current form of teams like Argentina and Spain, a first-time winner is unlikely.
